html:
The South Island of Phu Quoc is one of the most attractive areas on the island, famous for beautiful beaches, fishing villages, cultural sites, and scenic coastal roads. A one day private car tour from the Centre Hotel Area to South Island is the most flexible and comfortable way to explore this region.

With Vietlook Travel, you can fully control your itinerary, departure time, and visiting duration at each attraction.

Centre Hotel Area to South Island Distance and Travel Time

The distance from Phu Quoc Centre Hotel Area to South Island attractions ranges from twenty five to forty kilometers, depending on your travel route.

The total driving time is approximately one to one and a half hours one way, excluding sightseeing stops. Traveling by private car allows you to move smoothly between locations without rushing or waiting for group tours.

Suggested South Island Attractions

During your one day private car tour, you may visit:

  • Ho Quoc Pagoda

  • Phu Quoc Prison

  • Sao Beach or Khem Beach

  • Local fishing villages

  • Pearl farms and fish sauce factories

  • Sunset spots along the southern coast

You are free to adjust the route based on your interests.

Flexible Private Car Service for One Day

By choosing a one day private car service, you will enjoy:

  • Door-to-door pick up from Centre Hotel Area

  • Flexible departure and return time

  • Private vehicle for your group only

  • Freedom to customize sightseeing stops

  • No fixed schedule like group tours

Our driver will assist you throughout the journey and recommend suitable rest stops if needed.

Professional Driver and Comfortable Vehicles

Vietlook Travel provides:

  • Experienced local drivers familiar with South Island roads

  • Clean and air-conditioned vehicles

  • Safe and smooth driving experience

  • Baby seat available upon request

Vehicle options include standard cars, larger family vehicles, minibuses, and luxury Carnival cars.
